card.name: Words just before a study's location
card.fires_on: Verbs and prepositions like "in", "conducted", "working" or "study" that come right before a place where a study, program or event happens. The place is usually a country, region or population.

modes.label: Preposition before place
modes.description: The word "in" appears right before a country, area or year in a survey or study setting.
modes.example: Shanghai Daily has a web page set up that shows the geographic distribution of H7N9 infections and fatalities<< in>> China.

modes.label: Study or program verb
modes.description: A verb or noun describing a study or program that is about to name where it is done.
modes.example: A large prospective 10 year observational cohort study<< conducted>> in the United States found no statistically significant

modes.label: Intro to development topic
modes.description: A verb that begins a description of aid or policy work in a country.
modes.example: is<< working>> to improve primary education for ethnic minorities.

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese words for rural and local communities such as 城乡, 基层 and 老百姓, and the word district. It pushes away from global and international terms.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a study or program names the place or local population it covers.
